newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hashimoto says Japanese reforms good for Asia.
newsitem.headline: Hashimoto says Japanese reforms good for Asia.

text.p: Planned reforms of Japan's fiscal, financial and other systems should help expand access to Japanese markets for other Asian countries, Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Tuesday.
Hashimoto, in a speech in Singapore on the last stop of a Southeast Asian trip, said Japan's reforms will also help boost financial markets in other Asian nations.
He said Japan plans to carry out reforms to its administrative, fiscal, economic, social welfare, financial and education systems.

"Such reforms are likely to boost the attractiveness of Japan as a place to do business... At the same time, our reforms are expected to expand the access of ASEAN and other countries to the Japanese market," he said.
"I believe the reforms will also likely contribute to the development of Asian economies and financial markets like the one in Singapore," he said.
